capabilities: Sync highlights and annotations from BookOrbit
Sync personal reviews and finished books
disambiguation: Sync is one-way only: it pulls highlights from BookOrbit into Obsidian, not the reverse.
extras: API key and password are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json; many settings changes only apply to a fresh sync and do not edit already-synced notes.
intentEvidence: I have taken inspiration from the official Readwise plugin on most functionality, but tweaked for self-hosted BookOrbit users.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import reading highlights and annotations from a self-hosted BookOrbit server.

relations.evidence: I have taken inspiration from the official Readwise plugin on most functionality
One-way highlight and annotation sync from BookOrbit to Obsidian.

summary: One-way sync plugin that pulls reading highlights, annotations, and reviews from a self-hosted BookOrbit instance into Obsidian notes.
